Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MRK.
Our cloud segment grew 20% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 177 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2022.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1343 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Revenue guidance of $26.3 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. We generated $19.2 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 20% to 16% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
